summary.text: Paul Terry is a Republican state representative from Belknap 7 who has served in the House since 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Terry has a career background as a Presbyterian minister and sat on the House Commerce and Consumer Affairs Committee in recent sessions.

paragraphs.text: Paul Terry was born in Southampton, New York, and graduated from Riverhead High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Union College and a master's degree in divinity from Gordon-Conwell Theological Seminary.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as a Presbyterian minister, and says he chaired the American Red Cross of Hornell, New York, and served on the Nicholas Noyes Hospital Board of Directors.
Terry was assigned to the House Commerce and Consumer Affairs Committee in the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
